name: max_pred_locks_per_relation
description: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked pages and tuples per relation before promoting to a relation-level lock.
symptoms: Unintended lock escalation under high concurrency
High shared memory usage from fine-grained locks
Lock contention due to premature promotion
tuning_tips: Use negative values (e.g., -2) to derive per-relation limits from max_pred_locks_per_transaction; increase positive values only when encountering frequent lock promotions and sufficient shared memory is available.
